Name: Marnie's Private Sale - Livestock Choices and Bulk Buying
Author: MiscMemos
Description:
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=3]Version 1.3.1 update: Barn and Coop tier requirements to purchase animals can now be bypassed. All coop animals can be bought and placed in the starter (level 1) coop. All barn animals can be bought and placed in your starter (level 1) barn.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]Important[/b][/heading]
[size=3]Renamed the mod to Marnie’s Private Sale because I got my sense of humor back after fighting the UI code.[/size]

[size=4]If updating from version [b]1.2.8[/b], delete the old [b]LivestockChoicesBulk[/b] folder before installing [b]Marnie’s Private Sale[/b]. After installing, double-check your GMCM settings to make sure they’re still set how you want.[/size]
[line]
[heading][font=Verdana][b][size=4]GMCM options[/size][/b][/font][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Blue Hen[/b] (Default false. Still requires Shane’s 8-heart event even if enabled, but after that the color can be specifically chosen.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Void Hen[/b] (Default false.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Golden Hen [/b](Available before Perfection. Default false.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Adult Animals [/b]- Livestock arrive ready to produce (Default false.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Real Animal Names[/b] rather than vanilla-style quirky names. (Default true.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Animal Price
[/b]Marnie’s having a sale. Maybe giving animals away for free. You decide.
Free / 90% off / 80% off / etc. / Full price (Default full price.)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Bypass Building (Coop/Barn) Tier [/b]requirement (Default false.)
If true, you do not have to have built or own a big barn/coop or deluxe barn/coop to be able to buy any animal (rabbit, duck, goat, sheep, pig)[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana][b][size=4]Animals offered[/size][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana]White Hen[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Brown Hen[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Blue Hen[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Void Hen[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Golden Hen[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]White Cow[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Brown Cow[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Duck[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Rabbit[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Goat[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Sheep[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]Pig[/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][font=Verdana][b][size=4]Bulk animal purchasing[/size][/b][/font][/heading]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana]Click the exact animal you want in Marnie’s shop to select it, then choose how many you want to buy at a time. Max 99.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana]After pressing [b]Buy[/b], naming and placing will happen for each animal bought without having to return to the shop menu.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[line]
[heading][font=Verdana][b]Credits[/b][/font][/heading]
[font=Verdana]This local fork combines and updates ideas/features from several earlier mods:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Original Livestock Choices[/b]: aedenthorn[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Bulk Animal Purchase[/b]: aedenthorn[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Livestock Choices - Continued[/b]: recon88[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Realistic Random Names[/b]: aedenthorn[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana]Thank you to the original authors for their work.[/font]

[font=Verdana]Extra thanks to [b]aedenthorn[/b], whose mods I apparently cannot live without, despite my ongoing attempt to keep my Stardew mod count under 100. This mod gathers several useful, open-permission livestock features into one expanded animal purchase menu.[/font]

Manifest.Name: Marnie's Private Sale
Manifest.Description: Marnie's holding a private sale. Choose produce-ready animals of the color you want in batches up to 99, negotiate prices, and get real name suggestions. Configure it all from GMCM. Lewis doesn't need to know.
Manifest.Author: MiscMemos
